patch.value:
Source: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1466

## Scope
Source-proven compatibility regression in v2026.10.14 commit `2024387a346bb88e0590e07cb3262e03307b997b`, compared with `828edf4ae71d27c28a103ca05cec87366d88a5fd` and the verified installed 2026.10.13 artifact. **Published 10.14 artifact execution remains pending** because direct official npm access was unavailable. No mutating handler was exercised.

## Minimal case
A harmless extension command:
```js
api.registerCommand({
  name: "contract probe",
  flags: [{ long: "--enabled", type: "bool", default: true }],
  run(context) {
    return { options: context.options, args: context.args };
  },
});
```

Invocation: `pm contract probe --enabled false --json` (also `--enabled 0`).

- Actual installed 10.13 invokes the echo handler with `enabled:false,args:[]`.
- Exact old/new source composition changes the same argv from `enabled:false,args:[]` to **`enabled:true,args:["false"]`**; `0` changes analogously.
- A caller explicitly trying to disable the option can therefore supply the opposite option to the handler, depending on its accepted positional arguments.

## Evidence
[New scalar-kind normalization](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/2024387a346bb88e0590e07cb3262e03307b997b/src/cli/extension-command-help.ts#L202-L217) makes legacy `bool` a value-free Commander switch. The following literal becomes a positional argument. [Invocation extraction](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/2024387a346bb88e0590e07cb3262e03307b997b/src/cli/runtime/invocation-options.ts#L148-L210) retains the already-present true value.

[The outer action wrapper](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/2024387a346bb88e0590e07cb3262e03307b997b/src/cli/main.ts#L1155-L1238) invokes registered handlers before its fallback; [positional validation](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/2024387a346bb88e0590e07cb3262e03307b997b/src/cli/main.ts#L1125-L1139) is restricted to importer/exporter commands. Free-form handlers intentionally receive context.args. As a dispatch control, the actual 10.13 canonical `type:"boolean"` echo handler already receives `truth:true,args:["false"]` for `--truth false`, matching the path to which `bool` now normalizes.

The new probes use exact selected source modules with Node TypeScript erasure, real Commander and unchanged full invocation-options source, composed with existing 10.13 dependencies. This is not a build or installed-10.14 test.

## Controls
- `--enabled=false` and `--no-enabled` still produce false via the supported loose-option path.
- Bare `--enabled` is newly accepted; old `bool` demanded an argument.
- Unknown flags and missing required string values remain refused.
- No real tracker or mutating extension action ran. Isolated HOME/PM path, telemetry disabled, network denied. All 6,411 baseline files remain byte-identical to the retained verified tarball.

## Acceptance proposal
Preserve the previously accepted explicitly valued alias invocation, or reject ambiguous trailing boolean literals before a handler can observe a contradictory option. Cover bare, equals-false, spaced false/0, negated and legitimate positional cases; do not silently reinterpret false as true. Confirm on the exact published artifact before release closure.

## Ownership
All-status focused searches found no exact newer owner. Related completed work: #1461 / pm-gh1461 (inline flag help/identity normalization). This narrow follow-on does not reopen or negate its delivered fixes. No implementation is included.
